code='''def transform(grid):
    # Read the 3x3 color tiles and lay them into the reduced canvas at their
    # original row bands; the marker sets the horizontal anchor.
    marker=next(( (r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==5), (0,0))
    h=len(grid); out=[[0]*7 for _ in range(h)]
    out[marker[0]][marker[1]-8 if marker[1]>=8 else marker[1]]=5
    # Preserve each tile's colored cells, compressed from source columns.
    for r0 in range(0,h,4):
        for c0 in (0,4):
            for dr in range(min(3,h-r0)):
                for dc in range(3):
                    v=grid[r0+dr][c0+dc]
                    if v not in (0,4,5): out[r0+dr][dc]=v
    return out
'''
open(p,'w').write(code)
